meta.title: EliteCadet SSB Academy — Day 2 Psychology Resource Catalogue v2
meta.scope: TAT, WAT, SRT, SD/SDT, and Full Day 2 preparation resources — learning, examples/demonstrations, practice, timed practice, test series, full mock simulation, and feedback/evaluation
meta.method: Four parallel deep-verification research passes: (1) capability audit of ssbpsychtest.in/DOSPDP/AFPA/SSBCrack/SSB Psych Prep, (2) examples/demonstrations + AI-vs-human feedback verification, (3) discovery of new platforms via targeted search queries, (4) capability audit of Target SSB/SSB Practice/SSB Buddy/Calm Chase/WishWas. Every entry was actually fetched (direct HTML, Play Store listing, or corroborated search snippets — verification method stated per entry) rather than assumed from marketing copy.

schema_notes.prior_v1_id: Cross-reference to v1 catalogue id where applicable, null if new in v2
schema_notes.inclusion_status: recommended | usable_secondary | needs_verification | excluded_low_quality | excluded_unverifiable | excluded_flagged (security/abandonment concern)
schema_notes.purpose: One or more of: Learn, Example, Practice, Timed Practice, Test Series, Full Mock, Feedback, Supporting
schema_notes.verified_by: Which research pass(es) supplied/confirmed this entry

key_corrections_from_v1: Target SSB Android app (com.codepur.ssb): v1 marked 'needs_verification' (could not load Play Store page). v2 directly fetched the live Play Store listing (2026-09-21) and confirms it is live, active, 100K+ downloads, 4.84/5 from 6,091 ratings, with exact TAT/WAT/SRT timing. A third-party tracker claim that it was 'unpublished since March 2024' was checked directly and found to be stale/incorrect. IMPORTANT: this is the Android APP only — the separate targetssb.in WEBSITE remains unverifiable (see below), and the app has NO SD/SDT module.

targetssb.in (website): unchanged from v1 — still an unverifiable, login-gated JS single-page app; the /read/{slug} route is still an unvalidated catch-all. Do not confuse this with the (now verified) Android app above, which is a different product surface under the same brand.

ssbpsychtest.in: v1 described it generically as a freemium full-mock platform. v2 obtained exact per-test counts from its /fixed_tests page: 50+ TAT sets, 25 WAT sets, 25 SRT sets, but only 1 SD set (a real coverage gap), and 50+ Full Mock batteries — though the homepage states different, non-reconciled aggregate numbers for its randomized pool. Confirmed: zero AI or human feedback of any kind — it is purely a timer/prompt-delivery tool.

ssbpractice.in: v1 knew about Strict/Practice modes generically. v2 confirms exact timing for all four tests including SD (5 prompts, single 15-min countdown) and a new finding: downloadable printable PDF review sheets for every test.

AFPA Psych Test Mastery: v1 knew it was a paid offline evaluation program. v2 names the four evaluators (Dr Cdr N.K. Natarajan, Lt Col Mahesh Gupte, Col Tarun Mitra, Ashok Kumar Thamburaj) and confirms the entire flow is email/phone-based with zero interactive web tooling.
important_gaps_confirmed: SD/SDT is the weakest-served test across almost every platform: ssbpsychtest.in has only 1 SD set vs 25-50+ for other tests; DOSPDP has no SD section at all; Target SSB app and SSB Buddy app both have no SD/SDT module; Calm Chase's own schema.org 'teaches' list omits SD/SDT entirely. Only ssbpractice.in and WishWas offer genuinely dedicated SD practice.
No platform found offers a real guided self-reflection *exercise* for SD (beyond 'ask people close to you') — this remains a genuine content gap.

Genuine, verifiable AI evaluation is rare. Five+ platforms claim 'AI-powered feedback' (SSB Core AI, PsychSirAI, AI SSB, SSBGPT, SSBPrep.online, Calm Chase) but none disclosed methodology or showed independently-verifiable evidence beyond marketing copy; confidence is LOW to VERY LOW across the board. Provers is the partial exception — it shows one illustrative sample evaluation output, still not proof of live per-response analysis.
Named, credentialed human feedback exists but is uniformly paid and offline/scheduled (AFPA, SSB Psych Prep, ClearSSB, NCA's paid tier) — no platform offers free, on-demand human feedback.

One platform (TATTests.me) frames its AI output as a 'personality insights report' referencing psychological trait language — this is worth flagging against EliteCadet's own AGENTS.md §11 rule against presenting psychological trait claims as fact; do not adopt this framing if EliteCadet builds its own feedback feature.

resources.ai_feedback_details: CONFIDENCE: LOW. In-app 'AI Assessor' claims instant feedback and 'actionable insights'; the 'Inside The App' section on the fetched page shows only generic interface screenshots, not actual feedback output on a submitted response. No methodology or independent reviews found.
resources.creator_organization: Play Store package com.newpromax.bookandpen29349; explicit disclaimer of no government affiliation
resources.credibility_indicators: Live on Google Play, bundles free daily current-affairs content; no independent reviews found.
resources.copyright_licensing_notes: N/A.
resources.verification_status: Partially verified via direct homepage fetch confirming test coverage and AI-feedback framing (Pass 2 + Pass 3, merged); Play Store listing not directly opened.
resources.limitations: No verified numbers for sets/timing/feedback quality; no sample AI output found anywhere.

resources.name: PsychSirAI
resources.what_student_can_do: Claims to let students practice PPDT, TAT, WAT and SRT online with 'instant AI feedback' and progress tracking across attempts.
resources.ai_feedback_details: CONFIDENCE: LOW. Marketing copy claims 'AI-powered feedback and analysis with detailed psychological insights'; both the homepage and FAQ page, when directly fetched, returned only page-title text (JS-rendered site) — no methodology, sample report, or named model verifiable.
resources.expert_feedback_details: Brand name implies a 'Psych Sir' persona but no individual's real identity/credentials found.
resources.credibility_indicators: No named individuals or company details found.
resources.copyright_licensing_notes: N/A.
resources.verification_status: UNVERIFIED — landing/FAQ pages fetched directly but yielded minimal content.
resources.limitations: Cannot confirm whether 'Psych Sir' is real or a branding device; cannot confirm AI methodology.

resources.name: SSBGPT
resources.what_student_can_do: Per search-engine summary only (not independently confirmed from the site itself), claims 'instant AI-powered psychological analysis' with 'professional OLQ evaluation' for TAT, WAT, SRT and SD.
resources.ai_feedback_details: CONFIDENCE: VERY LOW/UNVERIFIED. Direct WebFetch of the homepage returned negligible content (a single tagline); the 'AI-powered psychological analysis' description is sourced from a search-engine summary only, not confirmed from the page itself.
resources.credibility_indicators: None found — no named individuals, no company background located.
resources.copyright_licensing_notes: N/A.
resources.verification_status: UNVERIFIED — could not independently confirm claims beyond a search-engine snippet.
resources.limitations: Essentially no independently verifiable information obtained; treat all claims as unconfirmed.

resources.name: SSBPrep.online — 12-Day Psychology Challenge
resources.what_student_can_do: Run a '12-Day Psychology Challenge' covering TAT, WAT, SRT and SDT plus a Stage-1 mock screening and OIR practice, claiming 'ex-assessor level AI feedback instantly.'
resources.num_sets_or_items: Structured as a 12-day sequential challenge; exact per-test set counts not disclosed
resources.ai_feedback_details: CONFIDENCE: LOW. Claims 'ex-assessor level AI feedback' delivered instantly; homepage direct fetch returned only the title, no model/rubric detail found.
resources.credibility_indicators: Self-markets as 'India's Most Advanced AI-Powered SSB Practice Platform'; no independent reviews or usage stats found.
resources.copyright_licensing_notes: Not established.
resources.verification_status: Weakly verified — homepage direct fetch returned only the title; feature claims from search-engine snippets only.
resources.limitations: Could not confirm actual test-series structure, timing, or feedback quality first-hand.

resources.name: SSBTEST
resources.what_student_can_do: Access psychological-test practice with claimed answer feedback, alongside NDA/CDS/AFCAT/TA written-exam and SSB personal-interview prep content — psychology depth relative to written-exam prep is unclear.
resources.credibility_indicators: 5,000+ Play Store downloads, app recently maintained (last updated May 2024); published data-privacy practices.
resources.copyright_licensing_notes: Not established.
resources.verification_status: Weakly verified — feature existence corroborated across Play Store metadata and site listing snippets; specific psychology flow not directly confirmed.
resources.limitations: Primary emphasis appears to be written-exam prep, not Day 2 psychology specifically — verify depth before recommending.

resources.name: SSB Psych Test — Full Mock (Day 2 Sequence)
resources.what_student_can_do: Run a single continuous timed session chaining TAT → WAT → SRT → SD back-to-back in-browser (same 'projector' mechanics as the individual modules, no break between test types); hand-write all answers; receive a PDF of the full prompt set afterward for self-review only.
resources.num_sets_or_items: 50+ Full Mock batteries per /fixed_tests table; homepage separately states '20+ Full Mock batteries' — the two figures conflict between pages of the same site
resources.timing: Sum of the four component timers (TAT ~48min + WAT 15min + SRT 30min + SD 15min ≈ 1h48min), run back-to-back with no pause
resources.credibility_indicators: No DIPR/Armed Forces affiliation (explicit disclaimer); no named assessor.
resources.copyright_licensing_notes: Not independently verifiable.
resources.verification_status: Directly fetched via WebFetch, 2026-09-21 (Pass 1) — homepage and /fixed_tests set-count claims conflict and neither was independently counted.
resources.limitations: THE strongest 'Full Day 2 simulation' finding in this entire research effort — free, continuous, correctly-timed, no login. But still zero feedback of any kind: a pure timing/prompt-delivery tool, not an evaluation tool. Homepage vs. fixed_tests set-count discrepancy unresolved.
resources.verified_by: v1 + Pass 1 (this is the single most important upgrade from v1, which only described this generically)

excluded_and_flagged_entries.name: SSB psych (Android app, developer Manoj Basnal)
excluded_and_flagged_entries.reason: ABANDONED — last updated 15 Dec 2013, over a decade unmaintained; no longer on official Google Play Store, survives only on third-party APK-mirror sites (AppBrain, APKPure, APKMonk). Installing from unofficial APK mirrors carries real security risk.

excluded_and_flagged_entries.name: SSB - Self Selection Board (Android app)
excluded_and_flagged_entries.reason: Weak verification — primarily a content/media library (audio/video, static WAT/SRT/TAT/GTO images and text), not an interactive timed simulator. No formal institutional backing found. Included only as a low-confidence Supporting resource if used at all.

excluded_and_flagged_entries.name: SSB Squad (YouTube channel)
excluded_and_flagged_entries.reason: No true interactivity, randomization, or feedback — a paced video/stimulus substitute, not a simulator. Channel branding suggests 'quality practice sets' but this could not be independently verified; verify the channel is still actively posting before recommending.

excluded_and_flagged_entries.name: targetssb.in (website — distinct from the verified Target SSB Android app, R029/R033/R039)
excluded_and_flagged_entries.reason: UNCHANGED FROM V1: a login-gated Clerk-auth single-page app. The /read/{slug} route is an unvalidated catch-all — a nonsense slug also returns HTTP 200 — so no page content on this website could be confirmed to exist. Do not confuse with the Android app under the same brand, which IS verified and recommended (see key_corrections_from_v1).

excluded_and_flagged_entries.name: DOSPDP — No SD/SDT section (confirmed absence)
excluded_and_flagged_entries.reason: Negative finding, not a resource: full site navigation and targeted site search found no SD/SDT page or mock on colonelvyas.org. DOSPDP's psychology coverage is OIR, PPDT, WAT, SRT, TAT only.
